name: Uttarakhand
intro: The Char Dham of Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri and Yamunotri, Rishikesh and Haridwar on the Ganga, the Valley of Flowers and Hemkund, treks from Kedarkantha to Roopkund, Corbett's tigers, Nainital and Mussoorie, and the temples and snow views of Kumaon.
